title: Multiple Deprecated Dependencies (`glob`, `rimraf`, etc.) Found in electron-builder's dependency tree
body:
### Bug Report

**Description:**

When using pnpm to install or update dependencies in my project which uses `electron-builder`, I receive warnings about several deprecated sub-dependencies: `glob@7.2.3`, `glob@8.1.0`, `inflight@1.0.6`, `rimraf@2.6.3`, `rimraf@3.0.2`, and `@npmcli/move-file@2.0.1`.

I have run `pnpm update --latest`, but these warnings persist. Using `pnpm why`, I have traced these deprecated packages back to the dependency chains originating from `electron-builder`.

**Current Behavior:**

The `pnpm update --latest` (or `pnpm install`) command shows warnings including these deprecated packages:

```
 WARN  6 deprecated subdependencies found: @npmcli/move-file@2.0.1, glob@7.2.3, glob@8.1.0, inflight@1.0.6, rimraf@2.6.3, rimraf@3.0.2
```
(Note: `boolean@3.2.0` is being reported separately to the main electron repository.)

The relevant portions of the `pnpm why` command outputs for these deprecated packages are as follows:

```
pnpm why glob@7.2.3 output:
devDependencies:
electron-builder 26.0.12
└─┬ app-builder-lib 26.0.12
  ├─┬ @electron/asar 3.2.18
  │ └── glob 7.2.3
  ├─┬ @electron/rebuild 3.7.0
  │ └─┬ @electron/node-gyp 10.2.0-electron.1

  │     └─┬ cacache 16.1.3
  │       ├─┬ @npmcli/move-file 2.0.1
  │       │ └─┬ rimraf 3.0.2
  │       │   └── glob 7.2.3
  │       └─┬ rimraf 3.0.2
  │         └── glob 7.2.3
  ├─┬ @electron/universal 2.0.1
  │ └─┬ @electron/asar 3.2.18
  │   └── glob 7.2.3
  └─┬ electron-builder-squirrel-windows 26.0.12 peer
    └─┬ electron-winstaller 5.4.0
      ├─┬ @electron/asar 3.4.1
      │ └── glob 7.2.3
      └─┬ temp 0.9.4
        └─┬ rimraf 2.6.3
          └── glob 7.2.3

devDependencies:

      └─┬ make-fetch-happen 10.2.1

          └── glob 8.1.0

devDependencies:

  │           └── inflight 1.0.6
  ├─┬ @electron/universal 2.0.1
  │ └─┬ @electron/asar 3.2.18

      └─┬ make-fetch-happen 10.2.1

          │ └── rimraf 3.0.2

pnpm why @npmcli/move-file@2.0.1 output:

└─┬ app-builder-lib 26.0.12

    └─┬ @electron/node-gyp 10.2.0-electron.1
      └─┬ make-fetch-happen 10.2.1
        └─┬ cacache 16.1.3
          └── @npmcli/move-file 2.0.1
```

**Expected Behavior:**

I expect dependency installation to complete without warnings about deprecated packages. This would ideally mean that `electron-builder` or its intermediate dependencies are updated to use sub-dependencies that are not marked as deprecated.

**Steps to Reproduce:**

1.  Have a project with `electron-builder@26.0.12` listed as a devDependency.
2.  Use pnpm as the package manager.
3.  Run `pnpm install` or `pnpm update --latest`.
4.  Observe the warnings about deprecated sub-dependencies (`glob`, `inflight`, `rimraf`, `@npmcli/move-file`).

Could the dependencies within the `electron-builder` dependency chain (such as `@electron/asar`, `@electron/rebuild`, `cacache`, `temp`, `glob`, `rimraf`, `@npmcli/move-file`, etc.) be updated in a future release to use non-deprecated versions of these packages?

Thank you for your time and consideration.
